text: {"lessons":["My account grew overall, but it also had down months; I’ll judge progress over time rather than react to a single month.","I added repeatedly to A, B, and C, so I’ll keep an eye on concentration and avoid adding automatically without considering my overall holdings and cash.","Selling some B at a gain was one decision, not proof that I can time prices; I’ll make future trades deliberately and within the cash and shares I have."]}
